# CETRES Enginyers

> Civil engineering consultancy in Barcelona, founded in 1988.

CETRES Enginyers, SLP is a civil engineering office that prepares studies and designs, provides technical assistance, and directs civil works. The practice specialises in roads, motorways and structural design, and works with public authorities, concessionaires and private clients in Catalonia and Spain.

## Key facts

- Founded June 1988 in Barcelona
- Studies, construction designs, technical assistance and site supervision
- Fields: motorways, roads, structures, rail, underground works, urban development, signing
- Partners: Xavier Bosch i Solé and Carles Giner i Garriga, civil engineers (Caminos, Canales y Puertos), structures
